cohort: Women who died during their pregnancy or postpartum period between 2011 and 2016 in one of the 26 municipalities in the Ribeirão Preto Regional Health Department area, Brazil.
finding: The majority of maternal deaths were classified as direct obstetric deaths (77.8%), with hypertension, infection, and hemorrhage being the leading causes.
mod_finding: The mode of birth was not mentioned in the primary findings.
